correctness.rationale: For a split into dep(x,z) and dep(y,z), each x-row has fixed color r or s and each column y has a fixed right-end color; all assignments covered iff each edge agrees with one incident endpoint. For column pair (a,b), if a=b right endpoint covers both; otherwise no deletion needed exactly when a=r or b=s; if neither, one deletion necessary/sufficient. Hence min formula. Nine allowed alphabet sets A_(r,s) sizes 7 for r=s (3 cases), 6 otherwise (6). Independent exhaustive 511-subset inclusion-exclusion yields signed intersection differences 7:3,6:6,5:-21,4:18,3:-5; proves N_n for all n. Testing all 9^n colorings for n<=5 reproduces N_0..N_5=1,9,81,717,6057,48669. Three diagonal r=s strategies collectively charge at most n mismatches; balanced (0,1),(1,2),(2,0) columns force floor(n/3) deletions for every r,s, including n=0. Exact finite template proof is exhaustive and independent of n.
